title: Vegan Middle Eastern Fried Cauliflower
description: A crispy and flavorful vegan dish inspired by Middle Eastern cuisine, made with cauliflower and spices.
instructions: 1. Cut the cauliflower into florets and set aside.
2. In a shallow dish, mix together the flour, cornstarch, garlic powder, paprika, and salt.
3. Pour the lemon juice into a separate shallow dish.
4. Dip each cauliflower floret into the lemon juice, then coat in the flour mixture, shaking off excess.
5. Heat about 1/2 inch of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
6. Fry the cauliflower in batches until golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per batch.
7. Remove the fried cauliflower from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
